name: ai-engineering
summary: Initial baseline — building LLM/AI features WELL (the complement to the security pack's llm-security-reviewer). Provider-agnostic patterns for RAG pipelines, evals (offline harness + LLM-as-judge + regression gates), prompt engineering + structured output, agent/tool design (loops, human-in-loop, budgets), and the LLM gateway (routing / caching / cost+latency / fallback / streaming). An ai-feature-reviewer agent, an eval-run skill, an add-ai-feature command, and an ai-engineering-principles rule. Treats model output as untrusted (cross-links security llm-security-reviewer) and cost/latency as first-class.
